artworks.title: Self-Portrait with Wife Ernestine in a Balloon Gondola
artworks.description: A mustachioed man and a woman, both with light skin, crowd in the basket of a hot air balloon in this vertical, sepia-toned photograph. To our left, the man wears a tall top hat and a dark coat and cravat. With his body angled slightly to our right, he holds a pair of binoculars at his waist as he looks down and off to the side to our left. On our right, the woman wears a plaid patterned shawl that wraps around her body and seems to cover her head. A bow tied under her chin is a little wider than her face, and the wide ends of the ribbons reach far down her chest. She looks at us. The profile and torso of a person is cropped by the right edge of the photograph. Building on that, we eventually realize that the basket hangs a few feet above the floor in front of what must be a painted backdrop in a studio. The left edge is blurred and a sliver showing other people, or perhaps another exposure, is visible.

artworks.title: The Letter
artworks.artist: Albert Sands Southworth and Josiah Johnson Hawes
artworks.description: Two pale-skinned women wearing full, floor-length dresses sit angled to our left at the center of this vertical black and white photograph. The woman to our left sits on a patterned carpet wearing a black dress and holding an unfolded piece of paper in her lap. The woman to our right is wrapped in a patterned shawl worn over a lighter colored dress, and she leans against the shoulder of the woman to our left. Both look into the distance to our left. There is a chair upholstered with a floral-patterned fabric in the background to our left and a side table holding a bonnet, the ribbons falling over the edge, to our right. The women are mostly in focus and the rest of the room is a bit blurry, out of focus.

artworks.title: Darnel
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 42 x 12 cm (16 9/16 x 4 3/4 in.)
mount: 47.6 x 30.5 cm (18 3/4 x 12 in.)
artworks.creditLine: The Marvin Breckinridge Patterson Fund for Photography
artworks.description: This blue-toned print shows a cluster of long, thin plants with thin leaves and what look like seed heads in pale blue against a dark blue background. The plants are vertically oriented, and the different stalks have varying heights.

artworks.title: Dinnertime
artworks.description: The image shows two men working with a pair of horses in a plowed field. In the background, there are hills with trees under a softly textured sky. The photo is sepia-toned, giving it an antique feel. The composition leads the eye from the men and horses to the distant hills and trees.

artworks.title: Bal de la Bastille
artworks.artist: Louis Le Coeur and Jacques-François-Joseph Swebach-Desfontaines
artworks.medium: etching and wash manner, printed in blue, red, and black inks
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor dance or festival scene. The image depicts a lively gathering in an outdoor setting, illuminated by rows of hanging lanterns and ornate chandeliers. The scene unfolds under a darkened sky, set against a backdrop of lush trees. There are tents with stripes in the background. The foreground is crowded with figures engaged in dancing and merriment on a spacious dance area, while smaller details, such as a small dog, add warmth and a sense of communal gaiety.

artworks.title: Study of Horses
artworks.medium: charcoal and graphite on brown paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple horses sketched in motion, some seen in entirety and some partially visible. The drawing features three prominent horses on the left side, with two that are comprised only of a head and front legs and one that is drawn entirely and has a faceless rider sketched on its back. These horses partially overlap, and some of the lines drawing them are very light. There is also a standalone depiction of a horse's rear legs near the upper right corner. The drawing uses a dark medium on a light brown surface.

artworks.title: Horse and Rider
artworks.medium: oiled black chalk on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person sitting on a horse. The person is in a seated position atop the horse, with their upper body leaning slightly forward and legs straddling the animal. The person's facial features are not discernible, and their hair is minimally outlined. The person's clothing is depicted with simple outlines, without specific details. There are no objects or jewelry visible on the person. The horse is detailed, with defined muscles, head, and legs. The background has no distinct scenery, indicating a blank space.

artworks.title: Diana
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of the upper body of a person in a slight profile view. The person is positioned facing slightly downwards and to the left, with a gentle demeanor. Their facial features are delicately rendered, with soft lines portraying the nose, lips, and closed eyes. The person's hair is styled in a detailed manner, with curls framing the face and gathered at the back of the head. They are wearing a garment that drapes loosely over the shoulders, with etching lines indicating fabric folds. The background consists of textured hatchings. No jewelry or additional objects are visible in the image.

artworks.title: Young Woman Reading by a Window
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in a side profile view. She is sitting on a chair or low bench, focused on her hands holding fabric. Her face is in profile, with neatly styled hair, possibly covered with a cap. She wears a long dress and is surrounded by a small, detailed interior with soft light coming from a window. Potted plants are visible on the windowsill, and a woven basket hangs on the wall behind her. A table or furniture is partially visible to the right.

artworks.title: A Fashionable Noblewoman Wearing a Plumed Hat
artworks.medium: pastel on blue laid paper mounted on canvas (on strainer/stretcher)
artworks.description: This drawing shows a portrait of a woman from the chest up. The woman is looking at us, her body slightly turned to the left. She has fair skin with pink cheeks, dark eyebrows, round, green-gray eyes, and pink lips set in as slight smile. Her hair is light, styled in voluminous curls and topped by a large gray hat set at an angle, with blue ribbons on the left and large blue feathers on the right. She wears a blue-and-white dress with a puffy white neckline, with a bunch of flowers seemingly attached to her dress on the left in shades of pink, blue, and white, surrounded by gray leaves. The background is a soft blue color with hints of gray on the left and right. The drawing is oval shaped.

artworks.title: Richmond
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is in the lower third, with distant trees and hints of architecture. A large tree dominates the right side of the image, with intricate branches and foliage casting shadows. The painting features detailed brushstrokes capturing the texture of the landscape. The color palette is monochromatic with different shades of brown. In the distance, there are cows near water and figures walking away.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: brush and ink with watercolor over black crayon on paper

artworks.title: Erna Bathing in a Tub
artworks.medium: pen and ink over clear water washes over color crayons on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketched figure in a crouched position. The figure is viewed from a side angle, leaning forward with legs folded underneath. The face is abstract, with a blend of colors indicating an androgynous look. The hair is blue and green. The figure is nude, outlined with bold strokes in colors like yellow, orange, and green. The background has swirls and bright colors like red, blue, and green. Black lines and smudges add depth and energy to the image. There are no specific accessories or items shown with the figure.

artworks.title: Hunchback Gazing at a Windmill
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body view of a figure facing away from the viewer. The person is standing in a slight profile with their body leaning towards the right and their head turned upwards to the left. The figure has voluminous, curly hair cascading down and wears an oversized, floppy hat. They are dressed in a large, puffy tunic with elongated sleeves, billowy pants, and laced shoes. A broad sword hangs from their waist. In the background, there is a rural scene with a small house and a windmill on a flat landscape.

artworks.title: Joconde
artworks.artist: Jean-Claude-Richard, Abbé de Saint-Non, after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a room with three people. One person is seated on the edge of a bed, holding onto fabric. Another person in a gown is leaning forward, while the third person is lying in the bed. Two dogs are visible on the floor. The room has draped curtains, and there are some objects on the left side. The image is in a monochrome, sketch-like style.

artworks.title: Hunchback Brandishing Two Swords
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in a dynamic, aggressive stance, holding two swords and appearing to be in mid-stride. The person faces slightly to the right, with intense facial features and wild, swept-back hair. They wear a long-sleeved tunic, close-fitting trousers, and shoes with curled toes. The background shows a simple building among greenery and bushes, with an empty sky filling the rest of the space.

artworks.title: A Capriccio of Palaces and a Loggia Facing a Classical Bridge
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on two joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: This image is an architectural perspective drawing of a grand classical terrace. It depicts a balustrade leading towards an ornate bridge with multiple arches, shields, and statues. In the background are detailed buildings, a tower, and mountainous forms along the horizon. The drawing uses fine lines in a pen and ink technique with a monochromatic palette. The scene conveys regal architecture, openness, and grandeur.

artworks.title: Saint Nicholas Rescuing Sailors
artworks.description: The drawing features a bishop-like figure with a crosier, surrounded by cherubs, positioned above a tumultuous scene of a boat in stormy waters.

artworks.title: Saint James Major Preaching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure standing above a group in a dramatic setting. The image depicts a central robed figure surrounded by a diverse group of figures located at various levels around them. There is a suggestion of celestial or mythological beings amidst swirling clouds above. The lower section includes figures in dynamic poses, with one figure holding a child and a dog walking in the foreground. The composition has detailed line work creating texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Senior Government Auditor Rudolf Schadow (The Artist's Brother)
artworks.dimensions: overall (trimmed to image): 28.2 x 17.1 cm (11 1/8 x 6 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing in a formal outfit with distinct facial features. The man has a relaxed posture, with one hand in his pocket and the other holding a cane. He wears a tall top hat, a long overcoat, a waistcoat, trousers, and shoes. There are buildings and trees in the background, with a path lined with vegetation.

artworks.title: Radstadt near Tauern
artworks.artist: Johann Christoph Erhard and Johann Adam Klein after Carl Ludwig Friedrich Viehbeck
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a rural valley, a small town in the distance, a low horizon, expansive sky, hills, mountains, fine line work resembling traditional etchings, monochromatic color palette of black, gray, and white, detailed natural scenery and architecture, figures and animals including people leading horses, a town with church steeples and buildings, fields, trees, and distant mountains.

artworks.title: God Commanding Adam and Eve
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving a tree, a snake, and human figures. The drawing depicts a scene beneath a large tree full of fruit. A cloud-like formation emerges from the tree with a figure sitting on it and pointing downward. Below, two figures interact with the environment. One figure stands with folded arms, while another sits on the ground and gestures. A serpent is seen nearby. The style of the drawing is detailed and intricate, focusing on line work and shading to convey texture and depth in the figures, tree, and forms. Text at the bottom of the artwork suggests a narrative.

artworks.title: The Institution of the Eucharist
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a dramatic setting. The scene depicts a gathering of individuals, with several figures seated at a table and others standing around. Above the main group, two celestial figures are depicted with wings, interacting with the scene below. The setting includes architectural elements such as arches and a hanging chandelier. The light and shadow techniques create a sense of depth and atmosphere, emphasizing the intensity of the scene. The drawing suggests a moment of heightened emotional or spiritual significance.

artworks.title: A Study of Leaves
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 16.4 × 12.5 cm (6 7/16 × 4 15/16 in.)
sheet (trimmed within platemark): 17 × 13 cm (6 11/16 × 5 1/8 in.)
mount: 23 × 18 cm (9 1/16 × 7 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This image depicts a detailed view of lush foliage, with various large and small leaves taking up the composition. The leaves are intricately rendered with a focus on texture and detail, creating a sense of depth. The background is subtly shaded to highlight the vegetation. The color palette is dominated by warm sepia tones, enhancing the intricate patterns of the foliage.
